turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Hello, Mom. Let's look back at a visit together.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Mom, there's a large banner here that reads "Cal HACKS 13.0". It mentions San Francisco too. There are beanbag chairs on the floor of the hall, which looks cozy.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Look, Mom, a row of giant white letters stands on the floor, each one dotted with small lights. The little lights glow blue. Thin wires run between them, so gently.

turns.speaker: claude
turns.text: Now we can see the whole row of letters standing on a raised platform. Wide steps run along its edge. The hall around it is huge, with steel beams and long rows of ceiling lights.

note: They didn't say anything during this session.
